summary: Refresh only collection subscriptions whose inputs changed or whose reads need a retry

replay.detail: Collection refresh scheduling changes only; claim admission and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: Pending subscription IDs are kept in memory. No database schema or persistent state changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; no coordinated member upgrade is required.

compatibility.detail: The existing collection protocol, authorization checks, snapshot fences, current-row diffs and reconnect behavior are unchanged. Failed reads retry their own subscription; replacement, unsubscribe and permanent refusal clear its pending refresh.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption beyond a normal daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action or client configuration change is needed.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes or new binary swap-back restrictions.
